v0_baseline.non_interactive_limitation: Non-interactive elements (e.g., spans, divs, sections) are stripped of their element tags during browser-use prompt serialization and emitted solely as raw typography strings. Because stripped text nodes do not carry DOM node IDs in the serialized LLM prompt buffer, true 1-to-1 node-level mapping between AXTree nodes and prompt lines cannot be established for non-interactive elements. Text-content substring search serves as an indirect observation proxy.

channel_1_jsonld.name: Schema.org JSON-LD Structured Data

chromium_ax_tree_evidence.architectural_reason: Chromium Blink AXObjectCache does not construct accessibility objects for <script> tags; scripts have no display role or accessible presentation semantics.

browser_use_serialized_observation.architectural_reason: serializer.py:DISABLED_ELEMENTS includes 'script'; unconditionally pruned during tree creation.

channel_1_jsonld.comparison_verdict: CONCORDANT LOSS: JSON-LD is absent in both Chromium Accessibility Tree and browser-use Serialized Observation.

channel_2_button_accessible_names.name: Button Accessible Names (Interactive Elements)
channel_2_button_accessible_names.specification: W3C WAI-ARIA 1.2 accessible name calculation (aria-label on button without target-name co-location)

chromium_ax_tree_evidence.architectural_reason: Chromium calculates computedString from aria-label attribute with highest priority, superseding contents 'Add to Cart'.

browser_use_serialized_observation.architectural_reason: DEFAULT_INCLUDE_ATTRIBUTES explicitly whitelists 'aria-label'; node.is_interactive is True for <button>, so tag and attributes are serialized.

channel_2_button_accessible_names.comparison_verdict: CONCORDANT RETENTION: Button accessible names are retained in both Chromium Accessibility Tree and browser-use Serialized Observation without target-name co-location.

channel_3_non_interactive_aria.name: Non-Interactive ARIA Semantics (Price & Rating Spans)
channel_3_non_interactive_aria.specification: W3C WAI-ARIA 1.2 aria-label and role on non-interactive <span> / <div> elements

chromium_ax_tree_evidence.architectural_reason: Chromium Blink assigns generic or img AXNode for elements with aria-label, computing accessible name 'Price: $49.99'.

browser_use_serialized_observation.architectural_reason: serializer.py:L1046-L1058 serializes attributes ONLY if node.is_interactive or scrollable; non-interactive <span> is stripped entirely, retaining only child text '$49.99'.

channel_3_non_interactive_aria.comparison_verdict: CRITICAL DIVERGENCE: Retained in Chromium Accessibility Tree as accessible name on generic node, but stripped in browser-use Serialized Observation.

channel_4_custom_data_attributes.name: Custom Developer data-* Attributes
channel_4_custom_data_attributes.specification: HTML5 custom data attributes (data-action, data-product-id, data-field, data-amount)

chromium_ax_tree_evidence.architectural_reason: W3C Accessibility Object Model and Chromium AXTree ignore custom developer data-* attributes; they have no accessibility semantics.

browser_use_serialized_observation.retained_in_prompt: Retained on interactive elements under EXTENDED_ATTRIBUTES; dropped by default whitelist and dropped on non-interactive elements.
browser_use_serialized_observation.architectural_reason: Controlled by include_attributes whitelist; interactive elements retain whitelisted data-* attributes, but non-interactive elements are stripped regardless.

channel_4_custom_data_attributes.comparison_verdict: REVERSED DIVERGENCE: Absent in Chromium Accessibility Tree, but reachable in browser-use Serialized Observation (on interactive nodes) under extended configuration.

channel_5_visible_text.name: Visible Typography and Text Nodes
channel_5_visible_text.specification: DOM Text Nodes rendered in viewport

chromium_ax_tree_evidence.architectural_reason: Emitted as StaticText and InlineTextBox nodes, and as contents source for container accessible names.

browser_use_serialized_observation.architectural_reason: Text nodes of children are serialized as plain text blocks.

channel_5_visible_text.comparison_verdict: CONCORDANT RETENTION: Visible text is retained across both Chromium Accessibility Tree and browser-use Serialized Observation.

non_interactive_container_section.finding: Chromium AXTree retains container accessible name; browser-use strips non-interactive container tag.

non_interactive_price_span.finding: Chromium AXTree computes accessible name for span; browser-use strips span tag and retains only plain text.

icon_heuristic_small_span.finding: Small elements (10-50px bounds) with aria-label trigger the clickable_elements icon heuristic, retaining tag and label as an interactive widget.

interactive_data_button.finding: Absent in Chromium AXTree; accessible in browser-use under extended attribute whitelist.

empty_attribute_handling.finding: Both engines prune empty attributes and fall back to contents or omit empty values.

nested_button_elements.finding: Chromium AXTree computes name from aria-label; browser-use preserves button aria-label and concatenates inner text.
